description:
**What:** Delete AddressBookFilterCondition from addressbook.rs. draft-ietf-jmap-contacts-10 defines no AddressBook/query method and no filter type for AddressBooks. The struct is dead code that misrepresents the spec. backend.rs already correctly omits QueryObject impl for AddressBook with a comment explaining why.

**Algorithm:**
1. Delete AddressBookFilterCondition struct and its doc comment from addressbook.rs.
2. Remove AddressBookFilterCondition from the pub use line in lib.rs.
3. Remove it from the module-level doc comment in addressbook.rs.
4. Verify no test references AddressBookFilterCondition — if any do, remove those too.
5. Run cargo test -p jmap-contacts-types and cargo clippy -p jmap-contacts-types -- -D warnings.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- grep -r AddressBookFilterCondition src/ returns no results.
- cargo test -p jmap-contacts-types exits 0. Clippy clean.
title: Remove dead AddressBookFilterCondition struct (spec has no AddressBook/query)
